## BasesAllOptions type

BasesOptions and the associated sub-types are configuration-driven settings controls which can be provided by a [BasesViewRegistration](BasesViewRegistration.md) to expose configuration options to users in the view config menu of the Bases toolbar.

 1.10.0

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type BasesAllOptions = BasesOptions | BasesOptionGroup<BasesOptions>;
```
**References:** [`BasesOptions`](BasesOptions.md)<!-- -->, [`BasesOptionGroup`](BasesOptionGroup.md)
